description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a subclass of Fragment, which provides a UI component containing a custom LogView for displaying log data within an Android application. The class manages the creation and configuration of the views, including layout params, styling, and a listener to automatically scroll the log view when text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that hosts a LogView within a ScrollView, providing log output capabilities with automatic scrolling when new log data is added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styling, and padding; returns the root ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log when text changes, and returns the main view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the internal LogView instance.
